description: This file contains the implementation of a simple physics simulation involving balls bouncing and interacting, including setup and rendering functions for visual display.

classes.name: Ball
classes.description: Represents a ball in the simulation with properties and behaviors for movement, collision, and drawing.

methods.name: Ball:init
methods.description: Initializes a new ball with position, velocity, radius, and color.

methods.name: Ball:collision
methods.description: Handles collision detection and response with other balls and the mouse pointer.

methods.name: Ball:move
methods.description: Updates the position of the ball, applies collision physics, and constrains movement within window bounds.

methods.name: Ball:draw
methods.description: Draws the ball on the screen.
